<noinclude>{{Template}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Template:i18n}}
'''This template has only maintenance purposes. For linking to local translations please use interlanguage links, see [[Help:i18n#Interlanguage links]].'''

==Usage==

Without arguments it uses the current title (useful in English pages):

 &#123;{i18n}}

You can specify a title with the first argument:

 &#123;{i18n|Template:i18n}}

==Example==

{{i18n}}</noinclude><includeonly><div class="toc noprint" style="text-align: center; margin-bottom: 1em">
This template has only maintenance purposes. For linking to local translations please use interlanguage links, see [[Help:i18n#Interlanguage links]].
